query.title: Company Name Search
query.description: Legal company name to search in GLEIF LEI (and French SIRENE if enabled).

lei.title: Exact LEI Code
lei.description: Optional 20-character LEI code for exact lookup + direct/ultimate parent tree.

country.title: Country Code (ISO 2-letter)
country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code filter for GLEIF search (e.g. US, DE, FR).

vatNumbers.title: EU VAT Numbers
vatNumbers.description: EU VAT numbers with 2-letter country prefix to verify via VIES (e.g. ["IE6388047V"]).

includeFrenchRegistry.title: Include French SIRENE Registry
includeFrenchRegistry.description: Also search France's official SIRENE API when query is provided.

includeParents.title: Include GLEIF Parent Entities
includeParents.description: Fetch direct and ultimate parent LEI records when looking up an exact LEI.
